publication_derivation.changes: Only private absolute roots in command/path metadata are normalized; original identity and all original numeric values are unchanged.
publication_derivation.checkpoint_reference_base: checkpoint_file is unchanged and resolves against the original result directory, not this publication directory; weights are not exported.

section2911_resume.command_representation: Reproducible executed wrapper argv; executable is normalized to python and repository paths are relative, not private absolute paths.

cost_accounting.cost_scope: Each saved stage is counted once. training=gate+family; family includes base_family+CBF, so nested components are not additive again. Cumulative fields are excluded. Incomplete stages, failed work, loading and serialization are not in saved-stage totals.
cost_accounting.old_unsaved_task2_note: The interrupted old task2 consumed work but has no saved checkpoint or exact recorded stage duration. Its cost is unknown, not zero; old logs remain preserved. Seeds1/2 are outside this continuation and must not be charged again as new execution.

deadline_override.authority: docs/WORK_ORDER_2026-10-09.md Section29.11; explicit owner continuation without deadline
deadline_override.interpretation: The inherited deadline field is historical metadata, not an active execution cutoff. Only deadline checking is replaced; scientific configuration and training functions are unchanged.

selection_rule: mean seeds5/6 final validation BAcc at least original AACIL minus .03, then minimum mean signed forgetting; candidate comparison belongs to queue

test_cil_metrics.definition: mean over all classes introduced before final task, including Normal; max earlier recall minus final recall; signed, not clipped
test_cil_metrics.units: fraction; multiply by100 for percentage/percentage points

validation_metrics.definition: mean over all classes introduced before final task, including Normal; max earlier recall minus final recall; signed, not clipped
